title: docs(adr): ADR-0150 D3 records the `residual` holder kind (after #32412)
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT

Parent: #31527 (ADR-0150). Carrier for an ADR-0150 amendment row that PR #32567 (#32412) owes and cannot carry itself: `docs/adr/**` is a governed path (Tier H), and the epic does not mix it into a code PR. Precedent: #32375 (an ADR-0150 record row in its own docs PR).

## The row to add (text from PR #32567 `## Acceptance notes`, epic seat 2)

D3's holder vocabulary gains the `residual` holder kind:

- A stack's residual (ADR-0130 D4), `{ kind: 'residual', ownerId }`: the top level of the artifact whose id is `ownerId`, outside every package body. It is never a `package` holder, and it is named only as a refusal's candidate.
- Record line for red-line read 6793085339: the residual's job runs as the body that carries the artifact's id, or as no package. A name it shares with a body's job is refused, naming each declaring body and the residual.

Write it as a dated amendment note under D3, in the shape of the existing notes (for example "Amendment note (2026-11-10, #32060 item 1 — PR #32067)"), naming #32412 and the PR that lands it. Quote the landed code's file and symbol (`packages/core`, `PackageScopedHolder`), read at the merged head, not from this card.

## Order and review

- Blocked until PR #32567 merges, so the row describes landed code.
- Tier H: a human approves the merge. Reviewers per the standing rule (os-zhuang and hotlong).
- Further ADR-0150 amendment rows that epic children owe may join this card before it is dispatched. Each is added as a comment by the epic seat, with its source PR.

Blocked-by: #32412
